prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a native Android app, portrait 9:16
Primary request: Design Composition B for Pharma Auto as an invoice-context Material 3 editor. Structure in order: edge-to-edge status/top app bar taking 8% height; invoice summary and review progress taking 10%; compact scrollable line list taking 28%, with three visible lines and Line 1 selected; an anchored expanded editor sheet taking 42% with exactly four fields in two compact rows; sticky live total and save action taking the remainder. Keep neighboring lines visible so a pharmacy operator understands where the edit sits in the invoice.
Style/medium: impeccable conventional Material 3, light theme, white canvas, pale cool-gray list rows, deep forest green selected state and primary action, muted green tonal summary, amber only for OCR uncertainty, Android system typography, 48dp targets, modest 12-16dp corners, conventional navigation and form affordances.
Composition/framing: one full portrait app screen with no device frame. The expanded editor is an attached surface, not a floating modal. Clear selected-line state, generous labels for Arabic localization, no keyboard.
Text/data: "Pharma Auto", "Invoice review", "3 of 8 lines checked", "Synthetic example", "Line 1", "Item 60495", "2 boxes", "Line 2", "Needs match", "Line 3", "Ready", "Review commercial values", "Purchase unit price", "EGP 100.00", "Discount 1", "10%", "Discount 2", "5%", "Selling price per box", "EGP 150.00", "Net subtotal EGP 171.00", "Tax included", "New stock only", "Old stock preserved", "Save revision".
Constraints: use EGP only; exactly four editable commercial fields; current action saves an immutable review revision and does not write to Genius. No medicine names, supplier/customer details, testimonials, dates, or unapproved claims. No watermark.
Avoid: floating bottom sheet detached from context, excessive cards, decorative pills, gradients, glassmorphism, pharmacy cross, global repricing language, tiny list targets.
